sentences.en: Well, just to give you a few stats, since about 2014, over the last decade, enrollment in

sentences.en: So, over the last decade, Los Angeles public schools enrollment down 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 因此，在过去的十年里，洛杉矶公立学校的入学人数下降了20%。

sentences.zh: 费城下降了10%。

sentences.en: I can go on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 我可以一直列举下去。

sentences.en: And one reason it matters how many kids are going to school is because schools and school districts get funding based on the number of students that they have.
sentences.zh: 学校有多少孩子上学之所以重要，原因之一是学校和学区是根据学生人数来获得资金的。

sentences.en: So, they get money from the government, and it's all allocated per student.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们从政府获得资金，全都是按学生人数分配的。

sentences.en: And in some cases, districts have to actually pay if they lose a student to, say, charter schools.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，如果学区失去了一个学生（例如去了特许学校），他们实际上还必须支付费用。

sentences.en: So, there are real financial consequences for schools.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对学校来说有着真正的财务后果。

sentences.en: And one thing I think people don't realize about running schools is if your school shrinks by, say, 20 percent, you have fewer students, but you still often need the same number of
sentences.zh: 我认为人们对运营学校没有意识到的一点是，如果你的学校缩小了，比如说20%，你的学生少了，但你通常仍然需要相同数量的

sentences.en: teachers because the class sizes haven't shrunk so much that you can just eliminate a class.
sentences.zh: 老师，因为班级规模并没有缩小到你可以直接裁掉一个班的程度。

sentences.en: You still need a principal, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，你仍然需要校长。

sentences.en: You have a whole building to run.
sentences.zh: 你有一整栋楼要运营。

sentences.en: So, the costs don't necessarily scale down with the number of students.
sentences.zh: 因此，成本不一定会随着学生人数的减少而按比例缩减。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as you start losing kids, you start losing money.
sentences.zh: 随着你开始失去孩子，你开始失去资金。

sentences.en: I'm assuming that means you're starting to have to make some choices about what to cut.
sentences.zh: 我假设这意味着你开始不得不对削减什么做出选择。

sentences.en: You have to cut something, right?
sentences.zh: 你必须削减点什么，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And over the last year or so, we are really seeing a lot of districts starting to confront
sentences.zh: 在过去一年左右的时间里，我们确实看到很多学区开始面对

sentences.en: this problem and painful budget decisions, cutting bus routes, cutting substitute teachers, cutting the central office.
sentences.zh: 这个问题和痛苦的预算决定，削减公交路线，削减代课老师，削减中央办公室。

sentences.en: And more and more, they're doing something that is politically explosive, which is deciding whether to close schools.
sentences.zh: 而且越来越多的人正在做一件在政治上具有爆炸性的事情，那就是决定是否关闭学校。

sentences.en: And what does that look like, that politically explosive decision-making?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样的，那个在政治上具有爆炸性的决策过程？

sentences.en: I think closing schools is one of the most unpopular things you can do in education.
sentences.zh: 我认为关闭学校是教育界最不受欢迎的事情之一。

sentences.en: No one likes it.
sentences.zh: 没有人喜欢它。

sentences.en: No one ever wants it to happen to their school.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人希望它发生在自己学校身上。

sentences.en: As I was watching this debate play out in districts across the country, I kept seeing the same fight
sentences.zh: 当我看到这场辩论在全国各地的学区展开时，我一直看到同样的争论

sentences.en: happening, which is parents saying, we don't want this, and districts saying, we have to do something.
sentences.zh: 在发生，那就是家长们说，我们不希望这样，而学区则说，我们必须做点什么。

sentences.en: But on top of all of that, there's also this other question at play, which is about equality.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，还有另一个发挥作用的问题，那就是关于平等。

sentences.en: Because our schools in America are quite segregated by race and class.
sentences.zh: 因为我们在美国的学校按种族和阶层划分相当分明。

sentences.en: They still are today.
sentences.zh: 今天依然如此。

sentences.en: And especially in these big cities with lots of kids and lots of different kinds of kids in the same school system.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在这些大城市里，有许多孩子，同一个学校系统里有许多不同类型的孩子。

sentences.en: When you start to ask, are we going to close schools?

sentences.en: Which schools are we going to close?

sentences.en: Which kids get prioritized?

sentences.en: Who are we going to serve?

sentences.en: Interesting.

sentences.en: So declining enrollment and constrained resources end up forcing people to engage with
sentences.zh: 因此，入学人数下降和资源紧缺最终迫使人们去面对

sentences.en: these really big questions, it sounds like, about race, about class, about who they want their school systems to serve.
sentences.zh: 这些非常宏大的问题，听起来像是关于种族、阶层，以及他们希望自己的学校系统为谁服务的问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in my hometown of Pittsburgh, they were actually a little further along in the process than some other places.
sentences.zh: 在我的家乡匹兹堡，他们在这个进程中的进展实际上比其他一些地方要快一些。

sentences.en: They had lots of kids.

sentences.zh: 特别是在过去的十年左右里，

sentences.en: Like lots of other places around the country, Pittsburgh public schools were closed for a long time during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 就像全国许多其他地方一样，匹兹堡公立学校在大流行期间关闭了很长时间。

sentences.en: They feel like in the current setup, when enrollment is down and some schools are getting
sentences.zh: 他们觉得在目前的体制下，当入学率下降，一些学校变得

sentences.en: smaller and smaller and smaller, it's just too hard to offer these services that families want and need.
sentences.zh: 越来越小时，要提供这些家庭想要和需要的服务实在是太难了。

sentences.en: So, for example, I visited a middle school that has seen its enrollment decline a lot over the years, and it isn't able to offer eighth grade algebra.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，我曾参观过一所初中，多年来它的入学率大幅下降，如今它已经无法开设八年级代数课了。

sentences.en: And why that matters is if students take eighth grade algebra, they can go on to take more advanced math and high school, maybe calculus, and then be better prepared for college.
sentences.zh: 为什么这很重要呢？因为如果学生学习了八年级代数，他们就可以在高中继续学习更高级的数学，比如微积分，从而为上大学做好更充分的准备。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So Walker's saying that the district needs to close schools and consolidate kids into fewer buildings.
sentences.zh: 所以沃克是说，学区需要关闭学校，并将孩子们合并到更少的校舍中。

sentences.en: Otherwise, they're not using their resources wisely and they can't actually provide the programming that they need to.
sentences.zh: 否则，他们就没有明智地使用资源，也无法真正提供所需的课程。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he defends the decision to close almost all of the magnet schools to move away from that
sentences.zh: 他为关闭几乎所有磁石学校并摒弃这一策略的决定进行辩护，

sentences.en: strategy because he believes that that is one of the reasons that these neighborhood schools
sentences.zh: 因为他相信，正是这些原因导致这些社区学校

sentences.en: are struggling to begin with, that they don't have enough kids and they're not getting the resources that they need.
sentences.zh: 一开始就举步维艰，因为它们没有足够的学生，也没有得到所需的资源。

sentences.en: You know, one of the things that always broke my heart was going to the bus stop when there's a school within walking distance of my house.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有一件事总是让我很心碎，那就是走到公交车站，而我家步行距离内明明就有一所学校。

sentences.en: And then I go to the bus stop and watch 50 kids get on 10 different buses to go all over the city.
sentences.zh: 然后我走到公交车站，看着50个孩子坐上10辆不同的公交车前往全市各地。

sentences.en: When in reality, I think what we would all hope as parents is, you know, we want our kids close.
sentences.zh: 而现实中，我想身为父母，我们所有人最大的期望都是，你知道的，我们希望孩子就在身边。

sentences.en: What the Pittsburgh Public School System says is that magnet schools were creating a lot of inequality in the system.
sentences.zh: 匹兹堡公立学校学区表示，磁石学校在体制内造成了极大的不平等。

sentences.en: You know, the magnet school system at its core was designed to keep middle class white families in the school district by creating these schools of choice.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，磁石学校系统核心的设计初衷，是通过建立这些自主选择的学校，把中产阶级白人家庭留在学区内。

sentences.en: And their perspective was, look, we shouldn't just offer Spanish at the Spanish magnet school.
sentences.zh: 他们的观点是，听着，我们不应该只在西班牙语磁石学校提供西班牙语课程。

sentences.en: Every elementary school should have Spanish.
sentences.zh: 每所小学都应该有西班牙语课。

sentences.en: We shouldn't just offer science and technology at the magnet school.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该只在磁石学校提供科学和技术课程。

sentences.en: Every school should have that.
sentences.zh: 每所学校都应该具备这些。

sentences.en: We need to look at, like, how do we create a school in that community that folks want to go to, right?
sentences.zh: 我们需要考虑的是，我们该如何在那个社区里建立一所人们愿意去的学校，对吧？

sentences.en: If I'm looking at a school where we can't provide gym full-time because we don't have a full-time gym teacher or there's no art or there's no music, right?
sentences.zh: 如果我看到一所学校，我们无法提供全职的体育课，因为我们没有全职的体育老师，或者没有美术课，也没有音乐课，对吧？

sentences.en: So the promise of the plan is that by closing schools and taking on some temporary short-term pain,
sentences.zh: 所以该计划许下的承诺是，通过关闭学校并承受一些暂时的短期痛苦，

sentences.en: that the district and the kids ultimately are going to be better off in the long term because
sentences.zh: 学区和孩子们最终将在长期内过得更好，因为

sentences.en: every elementary school will be able to offer art, music, STEM, which is science, technology, engineering, math kind of things, and a foreign language starting in third grade.
sentences.zh: 每所小学都将能够提供美术、音乐、STEM（也就是科学、技术、工程、数学类的东西），以及从三年级开始的外语课程。

sentences.en: So they want every student to have that.
sentences.zh: 所以他们希望每个学生都能拥有这些。

sentences.en: And then every middle school will be able to offer things like eighth grade algebra.
sentences.zh: 然后，每所初中都将能够提供诸如八年级代数之类的课程。

sentences.en: That's the argument from the district.
sentences.zh: 这就是学区方面的论点。

sentences.en: The argument is this is going to lift all boats, basically.
sentences.zh: 这个论点基本上就是，这将水涨船高，让所有人受益。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Even though there seems, feels like there's a lot of taking away, we're really working hard to make
sentences.zh: 尽管看起来、感觉上好像有很多东西被剥夺了，但我们真的在努力确保

sentences.en: sure that there's something added to every building when the students walk in on the first day of next year.
sentences.zh: 当学生们在明年开学第一天走进校门时，每个建筑里都会增添一些新的东西。

sentences.en: One thing that I think is really interesting that I've observed is what they're asking families to do is kind of make a bet that the district is going to deliver on its promise.
sentences.zh: 我观察到的一个非常有趣的事情是，他们要求家长们做的事情，有点像是在赌学区会兑现其承诺。

sentences.en: And if you're a family at a neighborhood school that you don't like all that much and you don't think is that great, this could be good news for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个社区学校的家庭，你对这所学校并不是很满意，也觉得它没那么好，这可能对你是个好消息。

sentences.en: You could say, oh, my school is going to get better.
sentences.zh: 你可能会说，哦，我的学校会变好的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: But if you're one of these other families who goes to one of these magnet schools or to a
sentences.zh: 但如果你是另外那些家庭之一，他们去的是磁石学校，或者是

sentences.en: high-performing school you really like, what they're asking those families to do is basically
sentences.zh: 一所他们真的很喜欢的表现优异的学校，他们要求这些家庭做的事情，基本上就是

sentences.en: trade something they're happy with for potentially an equal or worse option that they might not be happy with.
sentences.zh: 拿他们满意的现状，去换取一个可能并不让他们满意的、同等或更差的选择。

sentences.en: And that is the rub.
sentences.zh: 这就是症结所在。

sentences.en: So for those families who don't have a lot of confidence that this bet is actually going to pan out for them, who think, look, I don't like what's happening here, what are they
sentences.zh: 因此，对于那些对这个赌局能否兑现没有太大信心、心想“听着，我可不喜欢这里发生的事情”的家庭来说，他们

sentences.en: actually doing?
sentences.zh: 究竟在做什么？

sentences.en: It sounds like they're making their voices heard.
sentences.zh: 听起来他们正在发出自己的声音。

sentences.en: Are they taking action?
sentences.zh: 他们采取行动了吗？

sentences.en: That is the choice that families all across Pittsburgh are faced with right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是现在整个匹兹堡的家庭所面临的选择。

sentences.en: So they have to make a choice pretty much this school year, what they're going to do next year.
sentences.zh: 所以他们几乎必须在这个学年做出选择，决定他们明年要做什么。

sentences.en: And they have a few options.
sentences.zh: 他们有几个选择。

sentences.en: They can go along with this plan and say, I'm going to try what Pittsburgh is suggesting.
sentences.zh: 他们可以顺应这个计划，说：“我要试试匹兹堡建议的做法。”

sentences.en: They can consider leaving the school system.
sentences.zh: 他们可以考虑离开这个学区。

sentences.en: They can try to go to a charter school, which is a public school outside the district school system.
sentences.zh: 他们可以尝试去特许学校，这是一所位于学区体系之外的公立学校。

sentences.en: They could enroll in a private school if they can afford it.
sentences.zh: 如果他们负担得起的话，他们可以注册私立学校。

sentences.en: Some are considering, do I homeschool my kid?
sentences.zh: 有些人正在考虑，我要不要在家教育我的孩子？

sentences.en: That is the big question.
sentences.zh: 这就是最大的问题。

sentences.en: How many parents will leave because of this and how many will stay to see it through?
sentences.zh: 会有多少家长因为这个而离开，又有多少人会留下来看事情如何发展？

sentences.en: And we reached out to a bunch of parents to really try to understand, how are they thinking about this?
sentences.zh: 我们联系了一群家长，真的试图去了解：他们是如何看待这件事的？

sentences.en: How are they thinking about the trade-offs?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何权衡利弊的？

sentences.en: What are they planning?
sentences.zh: 他们的计划是什么？

sentences.en: What are they going to do?
sentences.zh: 他们打算怎么做？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了游戏《Connections》，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作游戏《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色听联觉的病症。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: So Sarah, tell me about the conversations that you've had with parents, what their plans are, and how they're thinking about all these changes to their schools.
sentences.zh: 萨拉，跟我聊聊你和家长的谈话，他们的计划是什么，以及他们如何看待学校的所有这些变化。

sentences.en: So I, along with two daily producers, Michael Simon-Johnson.
sentences.zh: 我呢，还有两位日常制片人，迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊。

sentences.en: Can you just tell me your name and where?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们你的名字和地点吗？

sentences.en: And Stella Tan.
sentences.zh: 还有斯特拉·陈。

sentences.en: Would you mind introducing yourself?
sentences.zh: 你介意自我介绍一下吗？

sentences.en: So your name and a little bit about that.
sentences.zh: 也就是你的名字和关于这方面的一些情况。

sentences.en: Talk to more than a dozen parents.
sentences.zh: 和十多位家长进行了交谈。

sentences.en: My name's Sean Mann.
sentences.zh: 我叫肖恩·曼。

sentences.en: I am Emily Sawyer.
sentences.zh: 我是艾米莉·索耶。

sentences.en: Shannon Streiner.
sentences.zh: 香农·斯特赖纳。

sentences.en: Naomi Chambers.
sentences.zh: 娜奥米·钱伯斯。

sentences.en: Single mother.
sentences.zh: 单亲母亲。

sentences.en: Jasmine Worthy.
sentences.zh: 贾斯敏·沃西。

sentences.en: Born and raised in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡出生长大。

sentences.en: I graduated from Pittsburgh Public Schools.
sentences.zh: 我毕业于匹兹堡公立学校。

sentences.en: All my children are at Pittsburgh Public Schools.
sentences.zh: 我的所有孩子都在匹兹堡公立学校上学。

sentences.en: I have a seven-year-old and a 10-year-old.
sentences.zh: 我有一个七岁的孩子和一个十岁的孩子。

sentences.en: I have four in public schools.
sentences.zh: 我有四个孩子在公立学校上学。

sentences.en: And this might be surprising, but one of the reasons closing schools has been so explosive is that even in schools that are under-enrolled...
sentences.zh: 这可能令人惊讶，但关闭学校之所以引起如此大的反响，原因之一在于，即使在那些招生不足的学校里……

sentences.en: It's known as an under-resourced school.
sentences.zh: 这里被称为资源不足的学校。

sentences.en: ...or even when parents acknowledge that their kids don't have everything that they should have in their schools.
sentences.zh: ……或者即使家长们承认他们的孩子在学校里没有得到应有的一切。

sentences.en: A lot of them don't have books that they should have.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人甚至没有应该拥有的课本。

sentences.en: Lots of families are still pretty happy with their school.
sentences.zh: 许多家庭对他们的学校仍然相当满意。

sentences.en: I feel safe there.
sentences.zh: 我在那里感觉很安全。

sentences.en: I know my children do.
sentences.zh: 我知道我的孩子们也是。

sentences.en: I just let my kids roam in the school.
sentences.zh: 我只是让我的孩子们在学校里自由活动。

sentences.en: I don't even be caring.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不用操心。

sentences.en: I know they're safe.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们很安全。

sentences.en: We're an economically strained community.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个经济困难的社区。

sentences.en: And there's a thing where my children will come home with bags of food and things like that.
sentences.zh: 这里有一种情况，我的孩子会带着一袋袋的食物之类东西回家。

sentences.en: And it's not just them that'll come home with the bags.
sentences.zh: 而且不只是他们会带袋子回家。

sentences.en: So it's never a moment where they're ostracized.
sentences.zh: 所以他们从来没有被排挤的时刻。

sentences.en: It's like, as a community, we're taken care of.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像，作为一个社区，我们受到了照顾。

sentences.en: It's like kind of a family.
sentences.zh: 感觉有点像一个大家庭。

sentences.en: These are families that they've built strong relationships at these schools with other students, with their teachers.
sentences.zh: 这些家庭在这些学校里与同学、与老师建立起了深厚的关系。

sentences.en: My son, he's been there since he was four.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子，他从四岁起就在那里了。

sentences.en: And they know him very well.
sentences.zh: 他们非常了解他。

sentences.en: He is a little rambunctious sometimes.
sentences.zh: 他有时有点精力过剩、调皮捣蛋。

sentences.en: But they know how to talk to him and get him back on track.
sentences.zh: 但他们知道怎么跟他沟通，把他拉回正轨。

sentences.en: They've seen him grow.
sentences.zh: 他们看着他长大。

sentences.en: They know what he's into.
sentences.zh: 他们知道他喜欢什么。

sentences.en: They know he loves Pokemon.
sentences.zh: 他们知道他喜欢宝可梦。

sentences.en: And according to parents, this support has had a huge impact on their kids.
sentences.zh: 据家长们说，这种支持对他们的孩子产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: My 10-year-old, Sienna, has Down syndrome.
sentences.zh: 我十岁的女儿西娜患有唐氏综合症。

sentences.en: She attends our neighborhood public school, Fulton.
sentences.zh: 她就读于我们社区的公立学校——富尔顿小学。

sentences.en: They were the only school that ever made us feel that school wanted her to be there.
sentences.zh: 那是唯一一所让我们觉得学校真的希望她去那里的学校。

sentences.en: What have your conversations been like with Sienna about the changes coming up?
sentences.zh: 你和西娜关于即将到来的变化的谈话是怎样的？

sentences.en: She doesn't grasp it, and I don't think that she will fully grasp it until we're at her new school.
sentences.zh: 她无法理解，而且我认为在我们去到新学校之前，她都不会完全理解。

sentences.en: I have a feeling that the anxiety will creep up on her right as we start.
sentences.zh: 我有一种感觉，焦虑会在我们开始的那一刻悄然向她袭来。

sentences.en: So I'm not putting too much attention on it now.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在没有把太多注意力放在这上面。

sentences.en: I'm trying to enjoy our last year at Fulton.
sentences.zh: 我正努力享受我们在富尔顿的最后一年。

sentences.en: In fact, she has the same teacher she had last year.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她教导她的老师跟去年是同一个。

sentences.en: And this morning before she left for school, her teacher sent home a book.
sentences.zh: 今天早上她去学校前，她的老师寄回了一本书。

sentences.en: And she read.
sentences.zh: 她读书了。

sentences.en: She read a book to me before she went to school today.
sentences.zh: 她今天去学校前给我读了一本书。

sentences.en: And it was like one of the most amazing things to witness.
sentences.zh: 这简直是最让人惊叹的见证之一。

sentences.en: And so we're just living in the joy of moments like that right now and making the best of this last year at Fulton with these amazing teachers and kids.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在正沉浸在这样时刻的喜悦中，和这些出色的老师和孩子们一起，充分利用在富尔顿的这最后一年。

sentences.en: The kids at Fulton are so welcoming and loving, and they make her feel like she belongs there.
sentences.zh: 富尔顿的孩子们是如此热情和充满爱心，他们让西娜觉得她属于这里。

sentences.en: And for us, that's a gift.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这就是一份礼物。

sentences.en: So these families are feeling a real sense of loss right now, a real sense of grief around these closures.
sentences.zh: 所以这些家庭现在感到一种真实的失落感，对这些学校关闭感到由衷的悲伤。

sentences.en: And they're also feeling anxious that their kids may have to go to bigger schools.
sentences.zh: 他们同时也感到焦虑，担心自己的孩子可能不得不去更大的学校。

sentences.en: You know, if our kids are coming from relatively smaller class sizes, and you put them in a big class, and then if the teacher is overwhelmed, then the students become overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我们的孩子原本处在相对较小的班级规模中，然后你把他们塞进一个大班里，如果老师应接不暇，那么学生就会感到应接不暇。

sentences.en: I mean, it just is a trickling effect that I don't think was thoroughly thought about.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这会产生一种连锁反应，我认为并没有经过深思熟虑。

sentences.en: They're feeling worried about their transitions.
sentences.zh: 他们对过渡期感到担忧。

sentences.en: And then for me as his mom to not be worried about my baby, wait, is he anxious?
sentences.zh: 然后作为他的妈妈，我怎么能不为我的宝贝感到担心呢，等等，他会焦虑吗？

sentences.en: Is he scared?
sentences.zh: 他会害怕吗？

sentences.en: But if he's breaking down and these teachers don't understand him because he has had behavioral
sentences.zh: 但如果他崩溃了，而这些老师又不理解他，因为他过去有过行为

sentences.en: issues in the past, and it's like, all right, well, we know Elijah, you know he's my emotional one, so we deal with it accordingly.
sentences.zh: 问题，就会变成：好吧，我们了解以利亚（Elijah），你知道他是那种感情比较丰富的孩子，所以我们会做出相应的处理。

sentences.en: But a different teacher will just be like, he needs to go sit in a corner somewhere and isolate him.
sentences.zh: 但换作别的老师只会觉得：他需要去某个角落坐着，把他孤立起来。

sentences.en: Will their kids regress academically?
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子在学业上会退步吗？

sentences.en: Will they have the sense of belonging?
sentences.zh: 他们会拥有归属感吗？

sentences.en: Like, what is going to be the situation in these new schools?
sentences.zh: 比如，这些新学校的情况会是怎样的？

sentences.en: And will their kids be able to make it through that and still learn and thrive?
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子能够挺过这一关，并且依然能够学习和茁壮成长吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It makes sense that they would be anxious about such a big change, but they were sending their kids to schools that were presumably suffering under the previous system, right?
sentences.zh: 他们会对这么大的变化感到焦虑是合情合理的，但他们之前把孩子送去的学校，大概也是在以前的体制下苦苦挣扎的吧？

sentences.en: Like, they were under-enrolled.
sentences.zh: 比如，他们的招生人数不足。

sentences.en: They were resource-starved.
sentences.zh: 他们的资源严重匮乏。

sentences.en: So I'm just wondering, do these parents believe in the idea that there might be real benefits here, improvements for their kids?
sentences.zh: 所以我只是在想，这些家长是否相信这里可能会带来真正的好处，为他们的孩子带来改善？

sentences.en: Well, we asked them that question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们问过他们这个问题。

sentences.en: So the promise from the school board is that at the new schools, everyone is supposed to get art, music, STEAM or STEM, PE, foreign language, all these different programs that
sentences.zh: 所以学校董事会的承诺是，在新的学校里，每个人都应该能上美术课、音乐课、STEAM或STEM课程、体育课、外语课，所有这些不同的项目

sentences.en: not every school has.
sentences.zh: 并非每所学校都有。

sentences.en: How do you feel about that promise?
sentences.zh: 你对这个承诺有什么看法？

sentences.en: I feel...
sentences.zh: 我觉得……

sentences.en: Excited?
sentences.zh: 感到兴奋？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I feel numb.
sentences.zh: 我感到麻木。

sentences.en: I'm very apprehensive that that's going to actually be the case with this.
sentences.zh: 我非常担心这种情况是否真的会实现。

sentences.en: And some of them are pretty skeptical of what the school board is promising and whether it can deliver.
sentences.zh: 他们当中有些人对学校董事会的承诺以及能否兑现持相当怀疑的态度。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't believe them.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不相信他们。

sentences.en: I just don't...
sentences.zh: 我就是不信……

sentences.en: If they've neglected us at Miller, I don't think they're all of a sudden going to start pumping resources to WOW.
sentences.zh: 如果他们在米勒（Miller）学校冷落了我们，我不认为他们会突然开始把资源注入到WOW学校。

sentences.en: They just keep telling us to trust them, and they've given us no reason to.
sentences.zh: 他们一直让我们相信他们，但他们根本没有给我们任何理由去相信。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So the families that you spoke to who stand to benefit from getting more from the district, it sounds like they're not sold.
sentences.zh: 所以你交谈过的那些本应从学区获得更多好处的家庭，听起来他们并不买账。

sentences.en: What about the families whose kids are already in relatively high-performing, well-resourced schools, including some of those magnet schools?
sentences.zh: 那些孩子已经在相对表现优异、资源充足的学校（包括其中一些磁石学校）就读的家庭呢？

sentences.en: I'd have to imagine they're even more skeptical of this plan?
sentences.zh: 我猜他们对这个计划会更加怀疑吧？

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And one thing we heard from them was a concern that all of these changes could erode the
sentences.zh: 我们从他们那里听到的一种担忧是，所有这些变化可能会侵蚀

sentences.en: quality of education at some of the more desirable, higher-performing schools in the district.
sentences.zh: 学区内一些更受欢迎、表现更好的学校的教育质量。

sentences.en: So several parents talked about this one school in particular, SciTech, which is a premier magnet school in Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 因此，几位家长特别谈到了其中一所学校——赛科（SciTech），这是匹兹堡一所顶尖的磁石学校。

sentences.en: It's focused on science and technology.
sentences.zh: 它专注于科学和技术。

sentences.en: It draws kids from all over the city.
sentences.zh: 它吸引了来自全市各地的孩子。

sentences.en: They apply to go there.
sentences.zh: 他们申请去那里上学。

sentences.en: They want to go there for this curriculum.
sentences.zh: 他们为了这个课程体系而想要去那里。

sentences.en: But under the new system, it's going to be merged and kind of become partial magnet, partial neighborhood school.
sentences.zh: 但在新体制下，它将被合并，某种程度上变成部分磁石学校、部分社区学校。

sentences.en: And the kids who are going to be coming in from the neighborhood are coming in from a school where very few students at the school are proficient in math and reading.
sentences.zh: 而那些从社区来的孩子，他们原本所在的学校里，极少有学生在数学和阅读上达到熟练水平。

sentences.en: And so current and prospective SciTech parents were worried about this.
sentences.zh: 因此，赛科学校现在和未来的家长们对此感到担忧。

sentences.en: If you look closer into the SciTech neighborhood school, you'll understand that that program is specific to very high-performing science and math-based prograMs.
sentences.zh: 如果你更深入地了解赛科的社区学校，你就会明白该项目专门针对表现非常优异的科学和数学课程。

sentences.en: Yet they're going to go just throw a bunch of kids that live in the neighborhood into that school.
sentences.zh: 然而他们却打算把一大群住在社区里的孩子直接扔进那所学校。

sentences.en: Well, they're not going to keep up the standards that they were expected to have.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们是无法保持人们期望他们拥有的标准的。

sentences.en: And so the question for some parents is, how do you maintain the academic rigor that we came here for?
sentences.zh: 因此，一些家长面临的问题是：你们如何维持我们当初为此而来的学术严谨性？

sentences.en: And also for other parents, how are you going to support the new kids coming in?
sentences.zh: 对于其他家长来说，你们将如何支持新来的孩子？

sentences.en: Are you going to set everyone up for success?
sentences.zh: 你们会让每个人都走向成功吗？

sentences.en: And fundamentally, many parents just aren't bought in.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，许多家长就是不买账。

sentences.en: They don't have enough evidence yet to believe that the school board's plan will accomplish what it was meant to accomplish, which was keeping students in the public school system
sentences.zh: 他们还没有足够的证据去相信学校董事会的计划能够实现其初衷，即把学生留在公立学校系统中

sentences.en: and making it more equitable.
sentences.zh: 并使其更加公平。

sentences.en: Can you say more about that?
sentences.zh: 你能多谈谈这一点吗？

sentences.en: Like beyond their fears that academic standards could go down at some of the more sought-after schools, why don't they believe that the system as a whole would become more
sentences.zh: 比如，除了担心某些备受追捧的学校的学术标准可能会下降之外，为什么他们不相信整个系统会在这些变动下变得更加

sentences.en: equitable with all these changes?
sentences.zh: 公平呢？

sentences.en: I think the best argument we heard came from this one parent.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们听到的最好的论点来自于这位家长。

sentences.en: My name is Abigail Folds, and I have two boys.
sentences.zh: 我叫阿比盖尔·福尔兹（Abigail Folds），我有两个男孩。

sentences.en: Who actually thought that magnet schools played a big role in offering equity and access to opportunity in the district.
sentences.zh: 她实际上认为磁石学校在为学区提供公平和机会获取方面发挥了重要作用。

sentences.en: You know, people love to say that that was the thing to keep the white kids in the district and everything.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，人们很喜欢说那是为了把白人小孩留在学区等等的手段。

sentences.en: But also, you know what it does?
sentences.zh: 但同时，你知道它有什么作用吗？

sentences.en: It gives an opportunity for some kids that can't afford to live in a richer area to have an education at maybe a different school, and that will no longer be an option.
sentences.zh: 它为一些负担不起在富裕地区居住的孩子提供了一个机会，让他们可以在也许是另一所学校接受教育，而这将不再是一种选择。

sentences.en: And she speaks to her own personal experience going to magnet schools and sending her kids to magnet schools.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了自己就读磁石学校以及把孩子送往磁石学校的亲身经历。

sentences.en: I grew up going to Pittsburgh Public Magnet Schools, and it was freeing to go and meet other people across the city.
sentences.zh: 我在匹兹堡公立磁石学校长大，去结识全市各地的人是一件让人感到解脱的事。

sentences.en: Neighborhoods are stifling in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 社区在很多方面都是令人窒息的。

sentences.en: You know, this whole notion of being able to be free and reinvent yourself and being able to decide who you are and not be pigeonholed into a certain type of kid, that is very much
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这种能够自由自在、重塑自我、决定自己是谁而不被死板地归类为某种特定类型孩子的概念，正是

sentences.en: the experience my family members have had.
sentences.zh: 我家庭成员所拥有的经历。

sentences.en: Basically, she says that magnet schools can be a way out.
sentences.zh: 基本上，她说磁石学校可以成为一条出路。

sentences.en: Your zip code doesn't have to be your destiny.
sentences.zh: 你的邮政编码不一定能决定你的命运。

sentences.en: And she actually thinks that getting rid of magnet schools runs the risk of reinforcing housing segregation and making schools more segregated.
sentences.zh: 她甚至认为，废除磁石学校有加剧住房隔离和使学校隔离情况更加严重的风险。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么会？

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么讲？

sentences.en: Because if you get rid of the magnet schools, she thinks the affluent families who already mostly choose affluent neighborhoods will 100% choose affluent neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你取消磁石学校，她认为那些本来就大多选择富裕社区的富裕家庭100%会选择富裕社区。

sentences.en: I live in a, quote unquote, undesirable neighborhood, and I think people would not move to my neighborhood if they knew they had to go to the neighborhood school, which is...
sentences.zh: 我住在所谓的“不理想”的社区，我认为如果人们知道他们必须去社区学校，就不会搬到我的社区，也就是……

sentences.en: They're not going to consider living in neighborhoods that maybe they would have if they knew that they could go to school somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 他们不会考虑在那些如果知道自己可以去别处上学本可能会考虑的社区居住。

sentences.en: This is what makes education and education policy so complicated, because you have school segregation and you have housing segregation, and it all interplays and intermixes.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么教育和教育政策如此复杂，因为你既有学校隔离，又有住房隔离，它们相互交织、互相影响。

sentences.en: But even if you buy the district's argument that basically we're going to funnel resources
sentences.zh: 但即使你认可学区的观点，即基本上我们将把资源

sentences.en: into these schools, we're going to give students art, music, STEM, algebra, we're going to give them all the same access and opportunities, some parents are saying that's naive.
sentences.zh: 投入到这些学校中，我们要给学生提供美术、音乐、STEM、代数，我们要给他们所有人同样的获取途径和机会，一些家长却认为这很天真。

sentences.en: Yes, you might get an algebra teacher at the school, but how many more kids will be prepared for algebra?
sentences.zh: 是的，你可能会在学校里配备一名代数老师，但会有多少更多的孩子为代数做好准备呢？

sentences.en: Do you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, will we have improved our education system at large?
sentences.zh: 比如，我们的整个教育系统真的改善了吗？

sentences.en: I just don't have any reason to believe that's true.
sentences.zh: 我只是没有理由相信这是真的。

sentences.en: I think it's hard to make a good school.
sentences.zh: 我认为要办好一所学校很难。

sentences.en: If you take one of the schools that's struggling and you just build a band room, is that going to do it?
sentences.zh: 如果你挑一所苦苦挣扎的学校，然后建一个乐队排练室，这管用吗？

sentences.en: Like, is that, is the art teacher going to fix it?
sentences.zh: 比如，美术老师能解决问题吗？

sentences.en: Or is it something else?
sentences.zh: 还是说问题在于其他方面？

sentences.en: We have made all kinds of educational changes and adjustments, and we're just constantly tinkering with the education system, and the same kids continue to get left behind.
sentences.zh: 我们做过各种各样的教育变革和调整，我们一直在不断地修补教育系统，而同一批孩子却继续被抛在后面。

sentences.en: And I just don't see the district with strong plans to make those improvements.
sentences.zh: 我只是看不到学区有做出这些改善的强有力计划。

sentences.en: And the whole plan basically requires families to go back into their neighborhood schools.
sentences.zh: 而且整个计划基本上要求家庭回到他们的社区学校。

sentences.en: But some of them are just saying, like, this doesn't make a lot of sense because there are other choices that we have outside the public school system.
sentences.zh: 但其中一些人却在说，这根本说不通，因为我们在公立学校系统之外还有其他的选择。

sentences.en: One, there's charter schools.
sentences.zh: 第一，有特许学校。

sentences.en: People can still leave, and now they just don't have an option within the Pittsburgh public school system.
sentences.zh: 人们依然可以离开，而现在他们只是在匹兹堡公立学校系统内部没有了选择。

sentences.en: People already are leaving, and people will just flee and flee and flee, and it'll be a race to the bottom.
sentences.zh: 人们已经在离开了，人们会不断地逃离、逃离、再逃离，这将是一场通往底部的竞争。

sentences.en: So you've closed one lever that was perhaps contributing to inequality, but then there's
sentences.zh: 所以你关闭了一个可能导致不平等的杠杆，但随后还有

sentences.en: this other lever over here, charter schools, homeschooling, maybe private school, that you're not even addressing.
sentences.zh: 另一个杠杆，也就是特许学校、在家上学，也许还有私立学校，而你甚至都没有去解决这些。

sentences.en: And how many of these parents are actually going to leave?
sentences.zh: 到底有多少这样的家长会真正离开？

sentences.en: Well, there's some preliminary enrollment data from this school year that suggests that
sentences.zh: 嗯，本学年的一些初步招生数据显示

sentences.en: some number of families, several hundred families, primarily families of means, left the school system this year.
sentences.zh: 有一部分家庭，几百个家庭，主要是经济条件较好的家庭，今年离开了学校系统。

sentences.en: Was that because of this?
sentences.zh: 这是因为这个原因吗？

sentences.en: Was that because of something else?
sentences.zh: 是因为别的原因吗？

sentences.en: It's hard to say definitively, but the fact that it was primarily families who are more economically better off, suggests that families who do have choices to make are using that
sentences.zh: 很难给出确定的说法，但事实是，主要都是经济状况较好的家庭，这表明确实有选择余地的家庭正在行使这种

sentences.en: choice.
sentences.zh: 选择权。

sentences.en: And I talked to one mom who is one of those parents.
sentences.zh: 我采访了一位身为其中一员的妈妈。

sentences.en: So I have a third grader.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一个读三年级的孩子。

sentences.en: We actually pulled him this year to go to private school.
sentences.zh: 我们今年其实让他退学去上私立学校了。

sentences.en: The word on the street, and we've seen it, is that private schools in particular are expecting a huge exodus of kids from this area to go to private schools.
sentences.zh: 坊间传闻，而且我们已经看到了，私立学校尤其正期待着该地区会有大批孩子出走去上私立学校。

sentences.en: So we decided to get a jump on that this year as opposed to next year.
sentences.zh: 所以我们决定今年就先下手为强，而不是等到明年。

sentences.en: In fact, his class size at the private school has doubled since last year.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他在私立学校的班级规模比去年增加了一倍。

sentences.en: She pulled one of her children out to go to a private school and is planning to pull her second child out to go to a private school.
sentences.zh: 她让她的一个孩子退学去上私立学校，并计划让第二个孩子也退学去上私立学校。

sentences.en: And she was pretty torn up about it.
sentences.zh: 她为此感到相当纠结痛苦。

sentences.en: So tell me a little bit about your decision to already take your third grader out and you have plans to take your sixth grader out.
sentences.zh: 所以跟我聊聊你决定现在就把读三年级的孩子转走，并且还计划把读六年级的孩子也转走的决定吧。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Tell me more about that.
sentences.zh: 多跟我讲讲这个。

sentences.en: I mean, since the beginning of this process, which started two summers ago, or three, maybe
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从这个进程开始以来——这始于两年前的夏天，或者三年前，也许

sentences.en: three summers ago at this point, it just feels like no matter what the parents say or try, our input is not being taken part of.
sentences.zh: 到此时已经是三年前的夏天了——感觉无论家长们说什麽或尝试什么，我们的意见都没有被采纳。

sentences.en: She was someone who was extremely involved in her kids' public school, but she just felt like it was too disruptive for her family.
sentences.zh: 她曾是一个极其积极参与孩子公立学校事务的人，但她只是觉得这对她的家庭来说干扰太大了。

sentences.en: Me and my husband, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我和我丈夫，对不起。

sentences.en: It's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Take your time.
sentences.zh: 慢慢来。

sentences.en: Because we both come from, both of our mothers were teachers.
sentences.zh: 因为我们俩都出身于……我们的母亲都是老师。

sentences.en: My sister's a teacher in public school.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐是公立学校的老师。

sentences.en: It's a hard decision to not send our kids to public school, but our philosophy is this is how we take it.
sentences.zh: 不把孩子送去公立学校是一个艰难的决定，但我们的理念是这样的。

sentences.en: We did not give up on public school.
sentences.zh: 我们没有放弃公立学校。

sentences.en: Public school gave up on our children.
sentences.zh: 是公立学校放弃了我们的孩子。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of parents who are staying, even some of the parents who were showing up at those public board hearings, so critical, so upset.
sentences.zh: 但有很多家长选择留下来，甚至包括那些出现在那些公开董事会听证会上、态度极其批判、极为沮丧的家长。

sentences.en: I am a white middle-class mom.
sentences.zh: 我是一个白人中产阶级妈妈。

sentences.en: I do think white and privileged people have a responsibility to stick, to stay, and be in these schools.
sentences.zh: 我的确认为白人和享有特权的人有责任坚持下去，留下来，待在这些学校里。

sentences.en: I have white boys who don't need to be centered in at least one aspect of their life.
sentences.zh: 我有白人男孩，他们不需要在生活的至少某一个方面成为中心。

sentences.en: I mean, we're sort of in the bullseye of the hegemony, so I think it's really important for them to have an experience where they are off balance and learning to get along with
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们某种程度上处于霸权的靶心，所以我认为对他们来说，拥有这样一种让他们感到不知所措并学会与

sentences.en: different people.
sentences.zh: 不同的人相处的经历真的非常重要。

sentences.en: I just think it's one of the most important things that I could do as a parent of white boys, is give them an experience like that.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，作为白人男孩的家长，我能做的最重要的事情之一，就是给他们这样一段经历。

sentences.en: I deeply believe in the idea of public schools as important to the democracy of our people.
sentences.zh: 我深信公立学校的理念对于我们人民的民主至关重要。

sentences.en: And I just could not give up on public schools.
sentences.zh: 我就是无法放弃公立学校。

sentences.en: I just theoretically have to commit to the good of Pittsburgh public schools and public schools for all.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，我必须致力于匹兹堡公立学校的利益以及人人享有公立学校的权利。

sentences.en: Some of them have just decided, like, I'm a public school parent and I'm staying.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人已经下定决心，比如：我是一名公立学校的家长，我要留下来。

sentences.en: I'm going to see this through.
sentences.zh: 我要坚持到底。

sentences.en: Did you consider private or charter?
sentences.zh: 你有考虑过私立学校或特许学校吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I can.
sentences.zh: 对，我考虑过。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, like, I'm sad to admit that.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我很遗憾地承认这一点。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I considered it.
sentences.zh: 我考虑过。

sentences.en: I didn't give it too much thought.
sentences.zh: 我没有多想。

sentences.en: I want to say, no matter where my kids go, they'll be fine because they got me.
sentences.zh: 我想说，无论我的孩子去哪里，他们都会过得很好，因为有我罩着。

sentences.en: But there's also a weight with that because there's that tug of war.
sentences.zh: 但这也伴随着一种沉重的负担，因为存在那种拔河般的拉锯战。

sentences.en: If I take my kids and put them somewhere else, it's either going to be charter or it's going to be private.
sentences.zh: 如果我把我的孩子带走并把他们放到别的地方去，要么是去特许学校，要么就是去私立学校。

sentences.en: And being a public education advocate, then I'm a hypocrite.
sentences.zh: 既然我是公立教育的拥护者，那我就是一个伪君子。

sentences.en: But then also, is it better for my kids?
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，这对我的孩子更好吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a tug of war over here.
sentences.zh: 对，这里简直像在拉锯战。

sentences.en: And it's exhausting.
sentences.zh: 而且这太累人了。

sentences.en: Also, I think there's just, I've observed, some level of shame around, like, if I make a different choice in this moment, am I abandoning the public school system?
sentences.zh: 另外，我发现，据我观察，大家内心有一种耻辱感，比如，如果我现在做出不同的选择，我算不算是抛弃了公立学校系统？

sentences.en: Like, what is OK for me to do in this situation?
sentences.zh: 比如，在这种情况下，我怎么做才算对？

sentences.en: We moved here for the public schools.
sentences.zh: 我们搬到这里就是为了这里的公立学校。

sentences.en: And so I kind of don't want to just bail.
sentences.zh: 所以我其实不想就这样一走了之。

sentences.en: But, like, everybody kind of moved up one notch on the how willing are you to bail spectrum, you know?
sentences.zh: 但是，大家对于“你有多大可能一走了之”这个问题的底线，都往上提了一档，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And so for some people, maybe they kind of already felt like they were about ready to send their kids someplace else.
sentences.zh: 所以对某些人来说，也许他们本来就觉得差不多该把孩子送到别的地方去了。

sentences.en: And so they just did.
sentences.zh: 于是他们就这么做了。

sentences.en: And I think that there's going to be a bunch of people for whom the district is kind of on probation.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，对于很多人来说，学区现在可以说是处于留用察看期。

sentences.en: We'll see how that first year goes.
sentences.zh: 我们得看看第一年情况怎么样。

sentences.en: I think it is your duty as a, like, a lot of my friends are educated, privileged.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，作为——我的很多朋友都是受过教育、享有特权的阶层，你的责任就是——

sentences.en: It is your duty to participate and send your kid to Pittsburgh Public Schools.
sentences.zh: 积极参与并把孩子送进匹兹堡公立学校，这是你的责任。

sentences.en: And I was very adamant about that and probably annoyed lots of my friends.
sentences.zh: 我过去对这一点非常坚决，可能也惹恼了我的很多朋友。

sentences.en: But I don't say it anymore because too much is up in the air.
sentences.zh: 但我现在不这么说了，因为有太多事情充满变数。

sentences.en: It's hard for me to imagine totally pulling out of the district.
sentences.zh: 让我完全退出这个学区，我很难想象。

sentences.en: But, I mean, I'm more committed to my kids than I am to the public school district.
sentences.zh: 不过，我的意思是，我对孩子们的责任感大于对公立学区的责任感。

sentences.en: So if I felt like that's what we needed to do, then I would definitely leave.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我觉得这是我们需要做的，那我肯定会离开。

sentences.en: And others are going to try it before making a radical change.
sentences.zh: 而其他人则打算在做出彻底改变之前先尝试一下。

sentences.en: But whether parents are staying or going for now, the common theme that I'm hearing you talk
sentences.zh: 但无论家长们目前是去是留，我听你谈论这一切时，

sentences.en: about through all this is just an extreme skepticism on the part of these families and a sense that trust has been loSt.
sentences.zh: 共同的主题是这些家庭普遍存在极度的怀疑态度，并且觉得信任已经荡然无存。

sentences.en: And if that kind of continues and if that pushes more parents to ultimately decide to take their kids out of the system, that would make this whole plan backfire, right?
sentences.zh: 如果这种状况继续下去，如果这促使更多家长最终决定把孩子带离这个系统，那岂不是会让整个计划适得其反吗？

sentences.en: And make the enrollment problem that produced this in the first place even worse.
sentences.zh: 并且会让导致这一问题的招生危机变得更加严重？

sentences.en: So I'm wondering, how does Gene Walker, the kind of spokesperson for this plan, respond to that?
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道，这个计划的代言人吉恩·沃克对此有何回应？

sentences.en: Well, he acknowledges that this is a possibility, but he still believes that it's the best option.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他承认这是一种可能，但他仍然认为这是最好的选择。

sentences.en: We've heard people say that school closures could actually drive families away, that this is not going to save the district, but actually be its demise or worsen your problem.
sentences.zh: 我们听人说过，学校关闭实际上可能会把家庭推开，这不仅拯救不了学区，反而是它的末日，或者会恶化你们的问题。

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that's a tough one.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，这确实是个难题。

sentences.en: It is kind of like a chicken and egg conversation, right?
sentences.zh: 这有点像先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: Which comes first, people leaving or needing to close schools.
sentences.zh: 到底是人们离开在前，还是需要关闭学校在前。

sentences.en: But I think ultimately, it will be up to us as a school district to fulfill our promise.
sentences.zh: 但我认为归根结底，兑现我们的承诺将是我们作为学区的责任。

sentences.en: And we can't let the threat of people leaving be the reason why we don't make the decision that's necessary.
sentences.zh: 我们不能让人们离开的威胁，成为我们不去做出必要决定的理由。

sentences.en: Because if we make the decision, people might leave.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我们做出决定，人们可能会离开。

sentences.en: If we don't make the decision, people might leave.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不做决定，人们也可能会离开。

sentences.en: And so I think there's always that risk.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这种风险一直都存在。

sentences.en: But if and when we are done with this process and we've done it successfully, the quality of education that we will provide will be the thing that brings people back to Pittsburgh,
sentences.zh: 但如果而且当我们完成这个流程并且取得成功时，我们将提供的教育质量才是把人们重新吸引回匹兹堡的东西，

sentences.en: not the buildings.
sentences.zh: 而不是这些建筑。

sentences.en: But he is very aware of what he's asking of families.
sentences.zh: 但他非常清楚他对家长的要求是什么。

sentences.en: This is a really hard thing to ask parents to do because our kids are in school for such a short period of time that a change like this is massive.
sentences.zh: 对家长提出这样的要求真的很难，因为我们的孩子在学校的时间很短，这样的变动太巨大了。

sentences.en: But ultimately, as a school board, we have an obligation, not just to the students that we have currently, but to the students that we will have 10, 15, 20 years from now, to
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，作为学校董事会，我们不仅对现在的学生负有责任，而且对10年、15年、20年后的学生也负有责任，我们要

sentences.en: create a system that is durable enough to take care of their needs long after many of us are done in these positions.
sentences.zh: 建立一个足够持久的系统，在我们在这些岗位上离任很久之后，依然能够照顾到他们的需求。

sentences.en: Sarah, you've been covering education in America for years now.
sentences.zh: 莎拉，你报道美国的教育已经很多年了。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering, after going deep on this case study of Pittsburgh and how it's
sentences.zh: 我在想，在深入研究了匹兹堡这个案例以及它如何

sentences.en: dealing with this national problem of declining enrollment in public schools, what is your takeaway about how the rest of the country should be dealing with this?
sentences.zh: 应对公立学校招生人数下降这一全国性问题之后，你认为全国其他地方该如何应对这一问题？

sentences.en: Well, Pittsburgh has chosen to deal with this in a pretty specific way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，匹兹堡选择用一种非常具体的方式来处理这个问题。

sentences.en: And I think one takeaway is the way that they're dealing with it is trying to raise the floor
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一个启示是，他们处理问题的方式是试图为所有学生，

sentences.en: for all students and specifically for the more vulnerable students that make up the majority of their school system.
sentences.zh: 特别是占其学校系统多数的弱势学生，提高教育的最低标准。

sentences.en: But the way that they decided to confront it in focusing on trying to lift the floor, they weren't paying as much attention to the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 但他们决定通过专注于提高底线来应对这一问题时，就没有投入那么多精力去关注上限。

sentences.en: The students who maybe are higher achieving, maybe wealthier, have more agency and options in their family.
sentences.zh: 那些成绩可能更好、可能更富有、在家庭中有更多自主权和选择权的学生。

sentences.en: And there might be a leak at the top.
sentences.zh: 高层可能会出现人才流失。

sentences.en: There might be a leak through the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 顶端可能会出现生源流失。

sentences.en: And that's a gamble, I think, that Pittsburgh Public Schools is making.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这就是匹兹堡公立学校正在下的赌注。

sentences.en: That is how they're doing it.
sentences.zh: 他们就是这么做的。

sentences.en: Other districts might take a different path.
sentences.zh: 其他学区可能会走不同的道路。

sentences.en: And either way, you kind of have some risk to that.
sentences.zh: 无论哪种方式，你都要承担一定的风险。

sentences.en: Because as I look around the country, the typical pattern that I see is districts have this problem with enrollment.
sentences.zh: 因为当我环顾全国时，我看到的典型模式是学区面临着招生问题。

sentences.en: They kind of put it off year after year.
sentences.zh: 他们一年又一年地拖延。

sentences.en: There's controversial meetings.
sentences.zh: 会议开得充满争议。

sentences.en: They don't do it.
sentences.zh: 他们没有行动。

sentences.en: They don't do it.
sentences.zh: 他们没有行动。

sentences.en: And then finally, you have to start doing something.
sentences.zh: 直到最后，你不得不开始采取行动。

sentences.en: And districts are often faced with a few different choices, none of which are good.
sentences.zh: 而学区往往面临几种不同的选择，没有一个是完美的。

sentences.en: So you could do the Pittsburgh path.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以走匹兹堡的路线。

sentences.en: You close schools.
sentences.zh: 你关闭学校。

sentences.en: It's very controversial.
sentences.zh: 这非常有争议。

sentences.en: There's another option where you actually try to right-size your staff for your shrinking student population.
sentences.zh: 还有另一种选择，那就是真正根据不断减少的学生人口来精简你的员工规模。

sentences.en: So you try to really intentionally lay off teachers, which is very unpopular and in some cases is not even possible because of different union negotiations.
sentences.zh: 所以你试图进行非常刻意的教师裁员，这非常不受欢迎，在某些情况下，由于不同的工会谈判，甚至是不可能的。

sentences.en: No easy solution here.
sentences.zh: 这里没有容易的解决办法。

sentences.en: But what I think is clear is that districts around the country are increasingly facing the reality that they can't put their heads in the sand.
sentences.zh: 但我想显而易见的是，全国各地的学区越来越认识到一个现实：他们不能把头埋在沙子里。

sentences.en: And I look around the country and Philadelphia voted to close schools.
sentences.zh: 我看看全国各地，费城投票决定关闭学校。

sentences.en: Austin voted to close schools.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀投票决定关闭学校。

sentences.en: L.A., Portland, they're having these discussions.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶、波特兰，他们都在进行这些讨论。

sentences.en: And so in some ways, this is a bigger societal problem, all now coming to roost for public schools.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，这是一个更大的社会问题，现在都集中降临到了公立学校头上。

sentences.en: And I think increasingly school districts are realizing we have to face it.
sentences.zh: 我认为学区越来越意识到我们必须正视它。

sentences.en: Well, Sarah, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，莎拉，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, House Republicans banded together to shelve an effort to impeach Defense Secretary
sentences.zh: 周二，众议院共和党人抱团搁置了一项对国防部长

sentences.en: Pete Hegseth on eight separate charges, including violating the Constitution to wage war in Iran.
sentences.zh: 皮特·海格塞斯提出八项独立指控的弹劾动议，其中包括指控他违反宪法对伊朗发动战争。

sentences.en: The House voted 211 to 204 to refer the Articles of Impeachment to a committee which allows Republicans to slow the process, at least until Democrats take control next year.
sentences.zh: 众议院以211票对204票通过投票，将弹劾条款交由一个委员会处理，这让共和党人得以拖延进程，至少能拖到民主党人明年接管众议院为止。

sentences.en: Only one Republican, Representative Thomas Massey of Kentucky, who spearheaded the effort, voted with Democrats against doing so.
sentences.zh: 只有一名共和党人、该动议的牵头人、来自肯塔基州的众议员托马斯·马西与民主党人一起投票反对这样做。

sentences.en: And House Republicans elected Representative Jim Jordan of Ohio to be their leader in the next
sentences.zh: 众议院共和党人选举来自俄亥俄州的众议员吉姆·乔丹担任他们在下一届

sentences.en: Congress, elevating a firebrand who's been a close ally of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 国会的领袖，从而将这位一直是特朗普总统坚定盟友的强硬派人物推到了更高位置。

sentences.en: Jordan, who's the current chairman of the Judiciary Committee, will replace Speaker Mike Johnson next year.
sentences.zh: 现任司法委员会主席的乔丹将于明年接替议长迈克·约翰逊。

sentences.en: He'll play a critical role in his party's efforts to chart a path back to the majority,
sentences.zh: 他在其党派重新夺回多数席位的努力中将发挥关键作用，

sentences.en: as well as to shield Trump and his administration from Democrats' congressional investigations.
sentences.zh: 同时也将保护特朗普及其政府免受民主党国会调查的冲击。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.zh: 选举迎进了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党便陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至令人惊心动魄的权力斗争中。
